objective: Implement the three-tier voice stack plan while preserving legacy routing and the Premium Gemini Live baseline; keep approval-dependent profiles disabled.
acceptance_criteria: Legacy agents without stackSelectionVersion retain their existing universal voice stack and tier behavior.
Canonical tier aliases normalize explicitly; unknown and disabled selections fail closed.
Validated tenant voice settings save atomically with a server-owned revision and stale revision conflicts.
Admin stack profiles and revisions reuse TierAssignment.stack_payload and ConfigVersion; startup does not overwrite persisted assignments.
Composed stack preparation and call execution use one immutable snapshot and never allocate Gemini Live or silently fall back to another model.
Premium retains its existing prepared Live session and one-time opening behavior.
Tenant-facing settings, catalog, previews, and errors expose only public aliases and approved retail rates.
Admin UI can configure and inspect readiness without exposing credentials to tenants or enabling unapproved profiles.
Adapters enforce bounded async I/O, cancellation, media validation, usage capture, and deterministic cleanup.
Changed acceptance criteria have fresh focused tests/static checks and user-visible flows have a Reticle verdict; external staging/production blockers are reported separately.
non_goals: No production activation, production config mutation, or schema migration execution.
No invented provider model, public model alias, voice capability, retail rate, FX value, or quality claim.
No rewrite of Premium realtime voice internals as the implementation path for composed stacks.
